name: How does upgrading insulation impact indoor air quality?
description: Improved insulation reduces air leakage, limiting outside pollutants and moisture, which can enhance indoor air quality and prevent mold.

mainEntity.name: How does upgrading insulation impact indoor air quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading insulation can positively impact indoor air quality by helping to create a tighter building envelope. This reduces uncontrolled air leakage, which means fewer pollutants, allergens, and moisture can enter your home from outside. A properly insulated and sealed home also helps to prevent condensation, which can lead to mold and mildew growth. While insulation helps, it's also important to ensure adequate ventilation to maintain fresh indoor air.
